required_user_actions: Provide either at least 140 GiB free at /mnt/core4-models for the complete set or at least 60 GiB for sequential single-model staging.
Acquire the four listed model quantizations from trusted providers into their exact destination directories; do not place weights in this repository.
Generate SHA256SUMS from the final local files and retain the source repository revision or release identifier beside each model.
Install or expose a qwen executable supporting the recorded headless JSON contract, or explicitly waive the Qwen Code adapter arm before the bake-off.
Configure Codex CLI with a local OpenAI-compatible provider without committing credentials or provider secrets.
Run local-coding-worker/scripts/inspect_host.py --json and verify usable_model_weights_present is true.
Then set CORE4-MODEL-ASSETS to ready with the todo-orchestrator decision command.
